answer: Reviewers stake to grade and a spot check re-grades a sample. Wrong verdicts cost stake, so sloppy grading is priced. Standing unlocks only after 30 days of continuous uptime, which a burst of new accounts cannot fake, and rewards vest against future work so an identity that quits early forfeits most of its delta. The lotus of a short-lived account never opens. A relic of old work counts only while new work keeps arriving.
